title: Symmetric group actions on the coordinate ring of the lower unipotent group and the polynomial ring with quantum parameters
summary: Givental-Kim and Ciocan-Fontanine gave an explicit presentation of the quantum cohomology ring of the flag variety. The author and Shirato introduced an algebraic generalization of their presentation in the context of the coordinate rings of regular nilpotent Hessenberg varieties. In particular, they connect the coordinate ring of the lower unipotent group in a general linear group and the polynomial ring with quantum parameters. In this paper we consider the dual of the connection and we see that the Plücker coordinates correspond to the quantizations of Schur polynomials. As an application…
